'''Simms''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chalactan/Legends|Chalactan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Chalactan/Legends|Chalactan]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Simms was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Embracing her Chalactan heritage, Master Simms had obtained the rank of [[Chalactan Adepts/Legends|Adept]] amongst the [[Convocation of Adepts]] as she wore both the [[Greater Mark of Illumination|Greater]] and [[Lesser Mark of Illumination|Lesser Mark]] of Illumination.<ref name="R79" />

Wielding a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of her own making, Master Simms selected [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Noirah Na]] as her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Both Master and apprentice were forced into military roles as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]; Master Simms was appointed as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] while Padawan Na took up the title [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]].<ref name="R79" />

Surviving three years of war, Master and apprentice were assigned to the [[Battle of Toola|campaign]] on [[Toola/Legends|Toola]], both joined by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Master [[Kai Hudorra]] in the fight. Leading their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from atop [[Mastmot/Legends|motmots]], Simms was successful in repelling the Separatist Army, until her clone troopers betrayed her. Unknown to the Jedi at the time, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was the alter-ego of the mysterious [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Sidious, under the guise of Palpatine, issued [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the Grand Army and they began to follow its directive: execute all Jedi. Directing Master Hudorra to take Padawan Na and flee, Master Simms laid down her life to allow the others to escape execution.<ref name="R79" />
